notes: Prepare Context phone 0.1.33/code34. Minute notes use a common zoom font and visibility threshold with native width-based wrapping and complete-line clipping, preserving all stored text. A bounded live label layer reflows while the committed grid and native background geometry remain stable. Fixed-size time labels become hour-only at dense zoom and share midnight-to-end-of-day alignment. Activity borders use their group fill color. Day view weekday/date headings align left; multi-day headings retain their alignment. Search replaces Redo on the phone toolbar; guarded Redo moves to Search's prior menu position. The pencil minute-range editor offers an optional Google-palette Fill color dropdown that preserves untouched minute words, formatting and group membership with guarded atomic Undo/Redo. Browser notes wrap at their uniform font size without adding browser zoom. Three static circular sync icons distinguish active, idle and issues with consistent stroke weight. Active link retries remain progress while genuine failures stay visible. Fresh exact-ID projection checks replace repeated full local collection reads, and retired links skip synchronization work without removing their history. Fresh provider reads and existing calendar edit, deletion, timestamp, consent, draft and transaction protections remain in force. Watch 0.1.15 and the emblem are unchanged. Both independent Android builds and publisher-signature checks must pass before availability records change; official store/catalog inclusion remains separate.
